newsitem.title: CANADA: Travel to Canada sets record in January.
newsitem.headline: Travel to Canada sets record in January.

text.p: Foreigners set a new monthly record for overnight trips to Canada in January, Statistics Canada said on Monday.
More than 1.5 million of the trips made to Canada in January included a stay of at least one night, up 1.8 percent from the month before, the federal agency said in a statement.

The number of overnight trips to Canada by foreign residents rose steadily from mid-1992 until early 1996, when it began to fluctuate. Americans made nearly three quarters of the overnight trips to Canada in January, with the 1.1 million total being the highest since February 1988, Statscan said.

Overnight trips to Canada by non-American foreigners reached another new high in January. The long-term trend in overnight trips by overseas residents has been on the rise, with their number doubling since January 1988, Statscan said.
Canadians made 321,000 trips to overseas destinations in January, unchanged from the record high set in December, the agency said. Mexico was the most visited country after the United States.
Canadians made 1.2 million overnight trips to the United States, a 6.8 percent drop from December. Florida was the favorite U.S. destination.
